messages:
tara-peopleops: Heads-up  we got reports that candidates imported via the batch CSV last night show up without assigned interviewers in the scheduler UI. Started popping around 07:10.

jon-recruiter: I saw it too when triaging outreach. The CSV had fields `interviewer_name` but our importer maps by email. Many rows have interviewer full name but no email, so assignments dropped. A few roles affected (~24 candidates).

mohit-ops: Can you paste a sample row?

jon-recruiter: Example row we got in the file: 
```
candidate_email,candidate_name,interviewer_name,slot
alice@example.com,Alice Chen,Samir Patel,2026-04-01T10:00:00Z
```
No interviewer_email column. Vendor thought name-only was OK.

andre-eng: Our importer expects `interviewer_email` or `interviewer_id`. When missing we create a placeholder assignment with `unmapped` status which doesn't surface in the scheduler and doesn't create invites. Quick patch: try fuzzy lookup by full name to map to email if unique. I'll push a small shim with warnings.

import-bot: ingestion-warning: 24 rows unmapped_interviewer detected -> ticket IMPORT-7214.

liz-talent: Some interviewers already submitted "no-show" flags because they never received invites. Candidates got stuck in pipeline. We need to remediate and reach out.

mohit-ops: Short remediate plan: (1) run a name->email reconciliation using our People directory for exact matches; (2) for ambiguous names, leave unmapped and surface to People Ops for manual mapping; (3) re-run assignment job to create invites for newly-mapped rows. I need calendar write scope for the re-run.

andre-eng: Implemented fuzzy-name lookup (exact match then initials fallback) in importer and a dry-run mode. PR #5239 created. Will run dry-run on the staging copy of last night's CSV.

jon-recruiter: Good. Also vendor needs to change their export contract to include interviewer_email. I'll ask them to add that column; they said they'll update next export.

tara-peopleops: Communication plan: send impacted interviewers a short note explaining we will reconcile assignments and not to mark no-shows until we confirm. Also inform candidates if their schedule is affected. I'll draft now.

andre-eng: Dry-run matched 18/24 unmapped names to unique emails, 6 ambiguous (e.g., two "Samir Patel"). Will run live reconcile at 09:15 PST after approvals.

mohit-ops: Approved to run live reconcile. Running job now: `python tools/reconcile_imports.py --file uploads/2026-03-23/batch.csv --map-by name --confirm`

import-bot: reconcile-job: matched=18 ambiguous=6 invites_created=18 duplicates_cancelled=0 time=2026-03-23T09:17:02Z

liz-talent: Reconcile complete. We sent manual mapping requests for the 6 ambiguous rows and scheduled interim phone screens for those candidates. Also flagged interviewers who marked no-show and reversed status.

jon-recruiter: Vendor confirmed they will include interviewer_email column in future CSVs and add a validation step before export.

tara-peopleops: Postmortem actions: update importer to prefer email, add schema validation to batch upload UI to reject name-only interviewer fields, update interviewer training to "if you don't get an invite, check with People Ops before flagging no-show", and add a brief to vendor contract. Closing IMPORT-7214; reopen if you see more unmapped rows. :white_check_mark:
